title: Hybrid JSON Mode + Lenient-Fallback Simulator for Schema Adherence
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Build a deterministic simulator that reproduces realistic streaming responses with partial JSON, interleaved tool calls, and intentional schema drift to validate the hybrid 'strict-json + lenient-fallback' behavior across models and runtime settings. The simulator will drive both the constrained-decoder path and the fallback converter so we can measure failure modes, recovery time, and data loss. Deliverables: (1) simulator harness, (2) test matrix and pass/fail thresholds, (3) GitHub CI job that runs key scenarios on PRs, (4) playbook for operators describing expected telemetry and mitigation steps.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator can generate 12 canonical failure scenarios: truncated JSON, extra trailing tokens, toolcall interleaving, wrong array types, missing required keys, null-for-required, enum drift, numeric-as-string, partial streaming frames, KV-cache-reordering, duplicate keys, and mixed-encoding characters.
For each scenario we define a gold-standard resolution: strict-accept, fallback-normalize, or reject-with-diagnostic.
End-to-end CI job executes against two model families (open-llama-7B/quant and redwood-lite-13B) and surfaces a matrix report.
Telemetry emitted for each run includes: schema_violation_code, decoder_mode, fallback_taken, tokens_to_recover, and reconstruction_success (boolean).
Run-time SLA: simulator runs within CI in under 25 minutes for the full matrix and flakiness < 1% across 20 runs.
Operator playbook created and reviewed by SRE and API reliability (link in links).
Security review completed for the harness since it will run customer-like payloads (security_review_required = true).
test_matrix: Dimensions: model_variant x streaming_mode (chunk_sizes 16/64/256) x decoder_config (strict, strict+soft-errors, lenient) x prefix_cache_state (warm/cold) x toolcall_frequency (none/low/high)
Expected outputs: Pass if (strict mode -> exact schema) OR (lenient mode -> normalized schema and diagnostic logged).
Failure triggers: silent schema loss (normalized fields missing) or malformed JSON after fallback attempt.
Metrics: false_positive_reject_rate, fallback_rate, average_tokens_consumed_before_recovery, and reconstruction_accuracy@lenient (0-100).
implementation_notes: Simulator will be implemented in Python and integrated with existing test harness used by streaming-schema-drift experiments.
Reuse parts of streaming reassembly code from ENG-42756 and the fallback normalizer from ENG-45120 (reference in dependencies).
Add lightweight contract layer that can swap in different normalizers per test (regex-normalizer, structural-rewriter, example-based mapper).
CI artifact: JSON report plus example failing traces saved to S3 for postmortem analysis.
Telemetry: instrument SDK hook that records per-chunk decoder_state and candidate_normalizations for offline analysis.
qa_steps: Run simulator locally against a single model variant with chunk_size=64 and verify the playbook example reproduces the expected diagnostic.
Open PR with simulator + two tests; ensure CI job appears and fails on introduced regressions.
Manual review: PM and Design to validate diagnostic messages are actionable (link to UX draft in links).
Smoke test rollout: run simulator against dedicated staging runtime and confirm telemetry pipeline receives schema_violation_code events.
